title: win-click: auto-dismiss empty-title transparent overlay (nfrunlite/nkrunlite)
desc: Physical click path: empty-title non-#32770 blocker overlays (e.g. nfrunlite transparent guard window) are auto-dismissed silently. Only named dialogs prompt error; transparent overlays get TryDismissBlocker + 200ms wait.
steps: Detect empty-title transparent overlay: string.IsNullOrEmpty(blocker.Title) && blocker.ClassName != '#32770'.
Auto-dismiss silently: physReadiness.TryDismissBlocker(hWnd, blocker) + Thread.Sleep(200). Log [WIN] empty-title overlay [className] auto-dismissed.
Named dialogs (title present or className==#32770) still return error unless --dismiss-blocker flag passed.
author: claude
